blocks.text: Organic compounds ko likhne (represent karne) ke liye kai qism ke formulae istemal hote hain.
1. Molecular Formula

blocks.title: Molecular formula
blocks.text: Woh formula jo kisi compound ke aik molecule mein har element ke atoms ki asal tadaad batata hai, molecular formula kehlata hai.

Maslan butane ka molecular formula C₄H₁₀, acetic acid ka C₂H₄O₂ aur ethanol ka C₂H₆O hai. Lekin molecular formula yeh nahi batata ke atoms kis tarteeb (sequence) se jure hain aur functional group kaun sa hai. Isi liye do mukhtalif compounds ka molecular formula aik ho sakta hai: ethanol aur methoxymethane dono ka formula C₂H₆O hai.
2. Empirical Formula

blocks.title: Empirical formula
blocks.text: Woh formula jo molecule mein har element ke atoms ka sab se chhota poore adad wala ratio (nisbat) batata hai, empirical formula kehlata hai.
Maslan butane (C₄H₁₀) ka empirical formula C₂H₅ hai (4:10 ko 2 se divide karein to 2:5), aur ethanoic acid (acetic acid, C₂H₄O₂) ka CH₂O hai.
3. Structural Formula
Structural formula sirf har qism ke atoms ki tadaad nahi batata balke yeh bhi dikhata hai ke atoms kis tarteeb se aapas mein jure hain.
Structural formula ki kai qismein hain.
(a) Displayed formula (Graphical formula)
Yeh structural formula ki sab se mukammal shakal hai jo khud hi sab kuch samjha deti hai.

blocks.title: Displayed formula
blocks.text: Woh formula jo molecule mein mukhtalif atoms ke darmiyan tamam bonds, un ki qism (single, double) aur functional groups ki jagah dikhaye, displayed formula kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed formulas jin mein har bond dikhaya gaya: butane, chaar C aik qatar mein, sire wale carbon par teen H aur beech walon par do do H; ethanol, H-C-C-OH aur har carbon ke oopar neeche H; ethanoic acid, teen H wala carbon aik aise C se jura jis ka O se double bond aur O-H se single bond hai.
blocks.caption: Butane, ethanol aur ethanoic acid ke displayed formulas (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Displayed formula mein har atom aur har bond nazar aata hai. Muqabla karein: butane ka molecular formula C₄H₁₀ aur empirical C₂H₅ hai; ethanoic acid ka molecular C₂H₄O₂ aur empirical CH₂O; ethanol ka C₂H₆O. Molecular formula sirf atoms ki ginti batata hai; displayed formula yeh bhi dikhata hai ke kaun sa atom kis se jura hai.
(b) Condensed formula (Linear Formula)

blocks.title: Condensed formula
blocks.text: Displayed formula bohat jagah leta hai, is liye aksar use aik line mein sukerh (condense) kar ke likha jata hai. Ise condensed ya linear formula kehte hain.

Is formula mein single covalent bonds nahi likhe jate, lekin branches (shaakhein), functional groups, double ya triple bonds aur molecule ke beech wale methylene (CH₂) groups brackets mein dikhaye jate hain, maslan:
(c) Skeletal Formula (Bond-line Formula)
Skeletal formula displayed formula ki aasan shakal hai jo bare aur pecheeda organic molecules dikhane ke kaam aati hai.

Skeletal formula mein carbon aur hydrogen ke symbols aur C – H bonds hata diye jate hain. Carbon atoms ke darmiyan bond seedhi lakeeron se dikhaye jate hain jo aik zaviye (angle) par milti hain. Har carbon ke baare mein samjha jata hai ke us par itne C – H bonds hain ke kul chaar bond poore ho jayein. Double aur triple bonds aur functional groups skeletal formula mein dikhaye jate hain. Maslan:

blocks.alt: Chaar qataarein, har aik mein naam, condensed formula aur skeletal formula: (i) butane, CH3-CH2-CH2-CH3, teen lakeeron ka zigzag; (ii) ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH, do lakeerein jo OH par khatam; (iii) methoxymethane, CH3-O-CH3, do lakeerein jo O par milti hain; (iv) ethanoic acid, CH3-C(=O)-OH, aik lakeer kone tak, wahan se dohri lakeer oopar O tak aur aik lakeer neeche OH tak.
blocks.caption: Butane, ethanol, methoxymethane aur ethanoic acid ke condensed aur skeletal formulas (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Skeletal formula mein har kona aur har lakeer ka sira aik carbon hai; carbon par lage H atoms nahi likhe jate, har C ke chaar bond poore samjhe jate hain. O, OH jaise doosre atoms likhe jate hain. Dekhein: ethanol aur methoxymethane dono C₂H₆O hain, magar dhaancha (skeleton) mukhtalif hai, is liye yeh isomers hain.
Quick Check 19.4

blocks.prompt: a) In ke displayed aur skeletal formulae banayein: i. 3,5-diethylheptane ii. 2-bromo-3,3-dichlorohexane iii. 2-methylbutanal
blocks.explanation: i. Saat carbon ki chain jis ke carbon 3 aur 5 par ethyl groups hon: CH₃CH₂CH(C₂H₅)CH₂CH(C₂H₅)CH₂CH₃ (C₁₁H₂₄). ii. Chhe carbon ki chain, carbon 2 par Br aur carbon 3 par do Cl: CH₃CHBrCCl₂CH₂CH₂CH₃. iii. Chaar carbon ki chain, carbon 1 par CHO aur carbon 2 par CH₃: CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CHO. Skeletal shakal mein har aik zigzag hai jis par yeh groups lage hon.

blocks.prompt: b) Ethanol aur methoxymethane ke displayed aur condensed structures banayein aur batayein ke kya yeh isomers hain.
blocks.explanation: Condensed: CH₃CH₂OH aur CH₃OCH₃. Dono ka molecular formula C₂H₆O hai lekin atoms mukhtalif tarteeb se jure hain (aik alcohol, aik ether). Is liye yeh aik doosre ke isomers hain (functional group isomers).

blocks.prompt: c) Ethanoic acid (CH₃COOH) ka skeletal formula banayein.
blocks.explanation: Aik chhoti lakeer (CH₃ ka sira) jo aik carbon tak jaye; us carbon par aik dohri lakeer =O ki taraf aur aik single lakeer OH ki taraf.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Molecular formula: atoms ki asal tadaad; empirical formula: sab se chhota poore adad ka ratio.
Structural formula ki qismein: displayed (har bond), condensed (aik line), skeletal (sirf lakeerein).
Mukhtalif compounds ka molecular formula aik ho sakta hai, maslan C₂H₆O: ethanol aur methoxymethane.
